_comment: Type-check ONLY — the shipped scaffold components (project/.sdk/src/cmp/**).
These compile inside a CONSUMER project, never as part of sdkgen's own
`tsc --build src test`, so a missing import or a renamed export is invisible
here and fatal there: every generated SDK of that language fails to build.
(That is exactly what happened with entityCollection in Entity_ts.ts.)
@voxgig/sdkgen is mapped to this package's own source so the components
resolve the same names a consumer would. fragment/ is excluded: fragments
are template source with placeholder tokens, not valid standalone modules.
